content: STEP 1 - goal: orient in the workspace and check what repository mechanisms already exist so the idea is not a copy. Reading the task workspace root listing first.

STEP 2 - goal: find a coupling position not already used by the earlier rounds, and check which designs are mathematically vacuous. Read: workspace root (only progress.jsonl, no repository code visible), plus the three prior round summaries in the task text (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook = successor-weighted Frechet CODEBOOK updates; CURVCTRL-SID = per-level curvature derived from a measured prefix-transition score; BRad-RQ = behaviour-entropy RADIUS ranking of items), and the rejected/probed names (Karcher mass, mixed-curvature fibres, cone/entailment, Lorentz smoothing, succboost geoshift).
OBSERVATION 1 (rules out an entire family): a per-item multiplicative weight does not change a nearest-code argmin, because the factor is constant across the code index. Likewise parallel-transporting the codebook to an anchor point and re-measuring distance there is a no-op, because hyperbolic parallel transport preserves the norm of a tangent vector. So "behaviour-weighted curvature/distance scale per item" and "pure transport" designs are computationally dead - behaviour must enter as a DIRECTION or a POINT that is code-dependent.
OBSERVATION 2 (the untouched axis): all earlier selections moved the CODEBOOK (centroids), the CURVATURE per level, or the RADIUS of items. None of them rotates the quantization TARGET inside the tangent frame of the current curved prefix at constant radius. That is the free position: behaviour sets an angular displacement (slerp of tangent directions) and geometry supplies the ball exp/log and the Mobius composition of the residual hierarchy, so the whole prefix path bends between levels.
EVIDENCE: task text round summaries; reasoning above is analytic, no repo files were readable.
OPEN: write the minimal spec (derived constants only: radius-relative code bound tanh(atanh(rho_max)/L), per-item coupling weight n_i/(n_i+nbar)), the 2x2 switch definitions, and the per-step cost at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs.

STEP 3 - final answer, idea SUCC-TANSLERP-RQ (Successor-Prefix Tangent-Direction Rotation in a Poincare RQ-VAE).

IDEA: SUCC-TANSLERP-RQ
TITLE: Curved target rotation: the successor-prefix tangent direction rotates each item's residual direction at constant Poincare radius before every RQ level assignment.
MOTIVATION: RQ-VAE semantic IDs are built to reconstruct an item embedding, so level-2 and level-3 tokens spend their capacity on residual detail of the item itself and carry almost no information about which item the user consumes next; the generative recommender then has to learn transition structure from the token sequence alone.
NOVELTY: previous mechanisms here moved the codebook (successor-weighted Frechet centroid updates), changed the curvature per level (measured prefix-transition score), or ranked items by radius (transition-entropy rank). This idea leaves codebooks, curvature and radii alone and instead rotates the quantization TARGET direction in the tangent frame of the current curved prefix, at constant geodesic radius, differently at every level, with a per-item coupling weight derived from transition counts and the prefix path composed by Mobius addition.
CHANGE: Before each RQ level the item's residual direction log_p(x) is slerped toward the successor-prefix tangent field, and the chosen code is the one whose Mobius step lands nearest that rotated target; the branch policy is to have the RQ-VAE encode transition-consistent residuals into the level-2 and level-3 tokens and hand the Stage 3 generator a prefix hierarchy that is already biased toward the next item's region.
SPECIFICATION: (see SPEC EQUATIONS) ball of curvature -1 (fixed), rho_max=0.9; ball embedding x=rho_max*z/(kappa+||z||) with kappa the running RMS of ||z|| measured over the first 200 steps; code u^l_k constrained to d(0,u^l_k) <= d_max/L with d_max=2*atanh(rho_max), L=3; per level target x~ = exp_p(||r||*normalize((1-lam)*r_hat + lam*s_hat)); assignment k_l=argmin_k d_P(p_(l-1) (+) u^l_k, x~); prefix p_l = p_(l-1) (+) u^l_(k_l); loss d_P(p_L,x)^2 + beta*commitment, beta=0.25 default.
COST: Stage 2 only. 24556 items / 24 steps = 1023 items per step, so per step: 3 levels * 256 codes * (Mobius add + geodesic distance, ~150 flops at D=32) = 38k flops per item per level, ~1.2e8 flops per step forward plus the same backward, against ~2.5e7 flops for the baseline Euclidean assignment: about +1e8 flops per step, 7.2e10 flops per epoch, 2.2e14 flops over 3000 epochs, i.e. roughly +15-25% Stage-2 step time and under +2% end-to-end wall clock. Successor aggregation adds one index lookup and a degree-weighted 32-dim sum per item per level (<6k flops/item/level); the detached prefix buffer is N*L*D floats = 9.4 MB. Stage 3 is unchanged (SIDs frozen).
HYPOTHESIS: it is worth keeping only if (a) the mean derived coupling weight over items with transitions is not collapsed (report mean lam, must be >0.15, else the mechanism is inert) and (b) the frozen Stage 3 run reports test_recall@10 > 0.065 (target) and above the programme baseline; observables that must move: SID assignment changes for items whose lam is high (level-2/3 token histogram shift measured against the behaviour-off arm's SIDs), prefix transition predictability at levels 2-3 rises, item reconstruction error may rise slightly.
RISKS: the successor aggregate is coarse, so the rotated target may leave the item's own manifold and hurt reconstruction and therefore token likelihood; constraining all three

code steps inside the ball radius cut caps expressivity of the last level; the detached successor buffer is stale by up to one epoch and can oscillate; most items may have very few training transitions, collapsing lam toward 0 and making the run a curved-RQ run; near-boundary arithmetic in the ball can blow up without clipping; the Stage 3 generator may not exploit prefix coherence, in which case recall stays flat.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: directed item transitions from the training sequences, aggregated per item into a successor-prefix tangent field, plus the derived per-item reliability weight n_i/(n_i+nbar).
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: from the training split only: count n_ij = number of times item j occurs immediately after item i across training sequences (and w_ij = n_ij/sum_j n_ij); n_i = sum_j n_ij; nbar = median of n_i over items with n_i>0, computed once before Stage 2 and frozen; the successor field at level l for item i is s_l(i) = sum_j w_ij * log_{p_l(i)}(P_l[j]) with P_l the detached prefix buffer (level 1 stores the successor item's ball point, levels 2..L its prefix points from its last appearance in a Stage-2 batch); lam_i = n_i/(n_i+nbar) capped at 0.9, set to 0 when the successor field norm is below 1e-6.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: transitions, counts, nbar and the prefix buffer are all computed from training-sequence interactions and from Stage-2 training batches only; the SID construction runs once and is frozen before Stage 3; no validation or test interaction, no validation or test sequence, and no Stage-3 score ever touches the counts, the buffer, the target rotation or the codebook, so nothing about held-out next items can enter the IDs.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare ball of fixed negative curvature c=-1: Mobius addition for the curved residual composition, geodesic distance d_P, and the exp/log maps that define the tangent frame at each prefix point; code radius bound derived by equal geodesic budget d_max/L.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: inside quantization, in the forward pass that turns an item embedding into its L-token SID, once per level, and in the reconstruction/codebook loss of Stage 2 training; nothing is added to Stage 3.
COUPLING PATH: one pathway: encoder output -> ball point -> per-level prefix p_l -> tangent frame -> (successor prefix field at the same depth) rotated target x~ -> Mobius-step candidate points -> distance-based code choice k_l -> prefix token of level l -> prefix of level l+1. The behaviour signal enters only through the rotation of the target, the geometry only through exp/log/Mobius/d_P at p_l; with lam=0 the rotation is the identity (behaviour inert), with Euclidean exp/log/Mobius/d_P the rotation becomes a flat vector blend and the composition becomes plain addition, so removing either changes the codes produced.
COUPLING EQUATION: x~_l = exp_{p_l}( ||r_l|| * normalize( (1 - lam_i) * r_hat_l + lam_i * s_hat_l ) ), r_l = log_{p_l}(x_i), s_l = sum_j w_ij * log_{p_l}(P_l[j]), lam_i = n_i/(n_i+nbar); k_l = argmin_k d_P^{c=-1}( p_{l-1} (+) u^l_k , x~_{l-1} ).
OBSERVABLES: mean and quartiles of lam; fraction of items with lam=0; per-level code usage entropy; SID identity change rate between arms (assignment observable); geodesic reconstruction error; prefix transition predictability = fraction of test-sequence prefixes whose next-token continuation is in the successor set of the prefix, recorded as a diagnostic only; frozen Stage 3 test_recall@10 as the sole judgement.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: config use_behaviour=F

alse, lam_i:=0 and s_l never read, so x~_l = x_i and the run is a plain curved (Mobius-composed) RQ-VAE; code exists, not trained in this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: config use_hyperbolic=False, exp/log/Mobius/d_P replaced by identity, weighted mean and L2, giving x~_l = p_l + ||r_l||*normalize((1-lam_i)r_hat_l + lam_i*s_hat_l) and additive residual composition; behaviour survives as a flat blend, curvature disappears; code exists, not trained in this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: the single trained candidate, use_behaviour=True and use_hyperbolic=True, one seed, 3000 Stage-2 epochs, frozen Stage 3 protocol, no early stopping, no sweep, no extra arm.
SPEC EQUATIONS: c=1 (curvature -1). Ball embedding x = rho_max * z / (kappa + ||z||), kappa = running RMS of ||z|| over the first 200 steps, rho_max=0.9. Derived code bound: d_max = 2*atanh(rho_max); for level l, project u^l_k <- u^l_k * min(1, tanh((d_max/L)/2)/max(||u^l_k||,1e-8)). Mobius: a(+)b = ((1+2<a,b>+||b||^2)a + (1-||a||^2)b)/(1+2<a,b>+||a||^2||b||^2). distance: d_P(a,b) = 2*atanh( min(||(-a)(+)b||, 1-1e-6) ). log: log_p(x) = (2/lambda_p) * atanh(min(||(-p)(+)x||,1-1e-6)) * ((-p)(+)x)/||(-p)(+)x||, lambda_p = 1-||p||^2; exp_p(v) = p (+) ( tanh(lambda_p*||v||/2) * v/||v|| ). Forward per item: p_0=0; for l=1..L: r=log_{p_{l-1}}(x); s=sum_j w_ij log_{p_{l-1}}(P_l[j]); lam = 0 if ||s||<1e-6 else min(0.9, n_i/(n_i+nbar)); d_hat = normalize((1-lam)*r/||r|| + lam*s/||s||); x~ = exp_{p_{l-1}}(||r||*d_hat); k_l = argmin_k d_P(p_{l-1}(+)u^l_k, x~) with straight-through (hard index, soft gradient to the chosen u); p_l = p_{l-1}(+)u^l_{k_l}; store p_l into the detached buffer slot (item i, level l). Loss: L = d_P(p_L, x)^2 + beta*mean_l d_P(p_{l-1}(+)u^l_{k_l}, sg[exp_{p_{l-1}}(r)])^2 + ||u^l_k - sg[log_0(x)]||-style codebook term using the geodesic distance to the code, beta=0.25 default, standard straight-through estimator. After Stage 2: SIDs = argmin indices per level, frozen, fed to the unchanged Stage 3 protocol.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: inputs: encoder output z in R^D, transition counts n_ij and derived w_ij, nbar, the detached prefix buffer P in R^{N x L x D}, codebooks U^l in R^{K x D} inside the ball. Outputs: the L-token SID (k_1..k_L) per item, the geodesic reconstruction loss and gradients for encoder and codebooks, and the diagnostics (lam distribution, per-level usage entropy, geodesic error).
SAFEGUARDS: clamp all ball norms to rho_max=0.9 before any Mobius operation and re-project to <=0.9 after every addition; epsilon 1e-8 in every denominator; clamp the argument of atanh to 1-1e-6; a zero-radius code or zero residual skips the exp/log and returns p (identity); lam is capped at 0.9 and forced to 0 when the successor field is missing (sparse-transition items, unstored buffer slots) so no item is dragged toward the origin by a phantom direction; the code-radius projection is applied after each optimizer step, not inside the graph; the successor buffer is written with detached values only and never back-propagated; buffer entries older than one epoch are refreshed lazily on appearance and items never seen fall back to lam=0; if the mean lam over items with transitions comes out below 0.05 the run is reported as behaviour-inert rather than re-tuned; loss is checked for NaN every 50 steps and, if hit, the failing Mobius denominator falls back to 1e-6 (no constant is changed).
END IDEA
